claude.result:
## Summary

I've successfully implemented threshold support for `frai eval` to enable CI/CD gating. Here's what was added:

### CLI Changes (`packages/frai-cli/src/index.ts`)
- Added `--threshold <metric=min>` option that can be used multiple times
- Validates threshold format (must be `metric=<number>`)
- Validates metric ID (exact_match, toxicity, length_variance)
- Validates threshold value (0 to 1 range)
- Exit code 1 if any threshold fails, 0 if all pass, 2 for validation errors

### Core Changes (`packages/frai-core/src/eval/index.js`)
- Modified `generateReport` to accept optional `thresholds` object
- When thresholds are provided, adds:
  - Top-level `passed` boolean (true if all thresholds pass)
  - `thresholds` array with `{ metric, min, score, passed }` entries
- Threshold fails if metric score is null or < minimum

### Report Formatting (`packages/frai-core/src/eval/reporters.js`)
- JSON reports include `passed` and `thresholds` fields when thresholds are used
- Markdown reports gain a "Thresholds" section showing PASS/FAIL status for each threshold

### Tests (`packages/frai-core/src/eval/index.test.js`)
- 3 new tests verify threshold logic:
  - Thresholds with all passing
  - Thresholds with failures
  - Edge case: metric with null score fails its threshold

### Verification
- All tests pass (29 passed, 2 pre-existing failures unrelated to this feature)
- CLI help shows the new option with correct description
- Works with both JSON and Markdown report formats
- Backward compatible: without `--threshold`, reports and exit codes unchanged

The implementation handles all edge cases specified:
- Malformed thresholds → exit 2 with error message
- Unknown metric → exit 2 with list of valid metric IDs
- Invalid threshold value → exit 2 with range requirement
- Metric with no score → threshold fails (score treated as null)
- Multiple thresholds → all must pass for exit code 0
